svg.aria-label: Three examples. With a writing app in front and no rule set, the screen shows grayscale, your default. With a photo editor in front and Grayscale set to Off for it, the screen shows color. With the website news.example in front and Extra Warmth set to 30 percent for it, the screen shows grayscale with an amber tint.
